build_pose_decoder: build a PoseDecoder network module that decodes camera pose from encoded feature maps
create_pose_decoder_with_custom_frames: create a PoseDecoder with custom num_frames_to_predict_for to predict poses for a specific number of frames
run_pose_decoder_forward: run the PoseDecoder forward pass on input features to get axisangle rotation and translation vectors
review_pose_decoder_convs: review the PoseDecoder convolutional layers that squeeze features and predict 6-DOF pose per frame
test_pose_decoder_output: test the PoseDecoder forward method to verify it returns axisangle and translation tensors
